identity: Redtusk herds and hunts the open savanna; scorpions, rats and a bandit water-broker skim the herds and the wells.

quests.title: [PH] The Held Supplies
quests.text: [PH] Borak wants the lashing cut on a water load Korr's bandits hold at the edge of the {name:bandit_camp}: water the herders found together, sold back to them. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Borak wants the lashing cut on a water load Korr's bandits hold at the edge of the {name:bandit_camp}: water the herders found together, sold back to them. Real text to follow.
[PH] Daro wants the stores and tools Vek's bandits took from the households that refused his tithe untied at the edge of the {name:bandit_camp}. Real text to follow.

quests.lesson: A use at a place at a camp's edge, out of its leader's sight.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3.5/§3.6 and K11 A: supplies the bandits hold at the edge of the existing camp, untied so they can go back; no water filling, no escort.

quests.title: [PH] Fodder for the Herds
quests.text: [PH] Borak keeps the herds fed: bring 8 Corn. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] Word for Kesh
quests.text: [PH] Borak sends word to Kesh Longstride at the outpost, who watches where the water goes. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] Sunleaf for the Watch
quests.text: [PH] Kesh's watchers need a remedy for the dry heat: bring 5 Sunleaf. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] Fences for the Pens
quests.text: [PH] Morga keeps herds, gates and supplies going: bring 8 Acacia Wood Fences. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] Zebras at the Water
quests.text: [PH] Waterhole Zebras crowd the herds off the water: hunt 8 of them by day in the {name:tallgrass}. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] Posts for the Shelters
quests.text: [PH] Morga builds shade over the waterholes: bring 12 logs of any tree. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A craft from Basic recipes; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] Rokka Counts the Barrels
quests.text: [PH] Kesh points the player to Rokka Emberhand, held in the {name:bandit_camp}, who knows the loads and where they came from. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] End {name:water_broker_korr}'s Trade
quests.text: [PH] Rokka demands the fight against Bandit Water-Broker Korr in the {name:bandit_camp}, who sells shared water back to the people who found it. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] Korr's trade is over; Rokka can name the buyers. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: The named perpetrator at his place; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] The Case Goes to Gor Drazhak
quests.text: [PH] Rokka sends the player to Thorga Roadspeaker in Gor Drazhak with the loads she saw sold, whether Korr still lives or not. Real text to follow.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: the departure id stays; free from 19, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §1, §2).
